Complete Guide, Controls & Developer Profile
🏎️ About The Game

Drive Mad Pro is a physics-based stunt driving game crafted for thrill-seekers. Navigate 50 meticulously engineered levels with independent multi-spring mechanical suspension, aerial gyro flip mechanics, breakable wooden bridges, launch ramps, and turbo nitro boosts—featuring Kamal Kahlon's hit Punjabi track "Daru Badnaam"!

🎯 Instructions & Stunt Balance
  • Cross The Finish: Guide your truck safely across steep gaps, loops, seesaw bridges, and finish line checkered flags.
  • Protect The Driver: If the yellow duck head impacts the terrain or obstacles, the vehicle crashes!
  • Master The Brake: Never hold full gas on steep downhills! Feather the BRAKE to keep your wheels planted.
  • Air Rotation & Flips: Lean back or forward while airborne to execute clean 360° backflips for bonus badges!
  • Turbo Boost Launch: Hit glowing cyan speed pads at top speed to rocket across perilous chasms.
